title: Hearing on street cleanliness and related sanitation bills
summary: The Council's Sanitation Committee held an oversight hearing on street cleanliness citywide, covering litter, illegal dumping, alternate side parking, graffiti, vacant lots and trash containerization. It also heard eight bills, including measures to expand organic waste rules for businesses, repeal a ban on alternate-side-parking violation stickers, reduce single-use items at street events, require dog waste bag dispensers and outreach, create a sidewalk cafe sanitation office, and address construction waste and dog waste removal. DSNY officials and advocates were expected to testify.
